title: Home Mortgage Loans Escrow Account Schedule by Program
content:
Escrow Administration holds the escrow figures for every Home Mortgage Loans program: the original loan-to-value above which an escrow account is mandatory, the one-time fee for waiving escrow where a waiver is open, the cushion carried in the account, the surplus at or above which a surplus is refunded, the months a shortage is spread over, the months between analyses, and the days after payoff within which the remaining balance is refunded.

| Program | Escrow mandatory above an original loan-to-value of | One-time waiver fee, as a percent of the loan | Cushion | Surplus refund threshold | Shortage spread over | Months between analyses | Refund after payoff within |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | always mandatory | not applicable | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | always mandatory | not applicable | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 percent | 0.25 percent | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 percent | 0.25 percent | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 80 percent | 0.25 percent | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 percent | 0.00 percent | 2 months of disbursements | $50.00 | 12 installments | 12 months | 30 calendar days |

## Notes to the schedule

On the FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage and the VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage the escrow account is mandatory on every loan, whatever the original loan-to-value, and no waiver fee figure is carried for them. On the other four programs the account is mandatory only where the original loan-to-value exceeds 80 percent.

The waiver fee is a one-time charge taken as a percent of the loan amount. It stands at 0.25 percent on the two Conventional programs and on the 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage, and at 0.00 percent on the Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage.

The remaining five columns carry the same figure on all six programs: a cushion of 2 months of disbursements, a surplus refund threshold of $50.00, a shortage spread over 12 installments, 12 months between analyses, and a post-payoff refund within 30 calendar days.
